notes.title: Patch 1.4.5：An update on the voice chat issue
notes.notes:
In the update implemented on 2025/6/16 15:00 PDT | 2025/6/17 0:00 CEST, we applied the following bug fixes and feature adjustments:
Fixed a bug where the transceiver’s effective range during the Investigation Phase was the same as that of regular voice chat.

Fixed a voice chat issue on the spectator screen.

Changed the default setting for the “Voice Chat” filter in room search to “No set.”


We apologize for any inconvenience caused by these issues.

Thank you for your continued support of DEATH NOTE Killer Within!
